<Travel coverage>
Looking to travel?

Question: "Flight Delay", Answer: "Should there be any delay from a 2 to 6 hour period due to bad
weather conditions, mechanical breakdown or other unforeseen circumstances, you will be
compensated up to a set limit stated in your plan.

*Subject to terms and conditions. Not applicable if alternative transportation is provided by the
transport company

Important notes 💡🤔️

Travel Delay calculation for (up to coverage limit of the plan) :
- International: RM100 for first 2 hours delay, RM250 for next 6 hours delay
-Domestic: RM 100 for first 2 hours delay"
Question: "Baggage Delay", Answer: "Delay in baggage arrival can be quite an inconvenience. If you
experience a delay of at least six (6) hours from the time you arrive at your travel destination, you
will be compensated based on the set limit stated in your plan.

Do note that this benefit does not cover baggage delays when you return from your trip.

Important note💡🤔️

This benefit can only be claimed under one coverage, either baggage delay / lost or damage
baggage"

Question: "Travel Outpatient Medical", Answer: "For any medical expenses during your trip :

- Below RM 3000 - Pay & Claims (This is for out patient or visit to Clinic treatments)

- If More than RM 3000 - Kindly contact our Travel Assists at +603 2785 6565 to request for GL
(Guaranteed Letter). Our Travel and Medical Assistance Helpline Number are operating 24 Hours X 7
days.

Emergency Travel Helpline: +603-2785-6565

*Kindly take note that Etiqa will not cover any pre existing sickness or illness"

<!-- page 6 -->
Question: "Trip Cancellation", Answer: "If there is a need to cancel your trip, we will reimburse the
cost up to a set limit.

Causes of cancellation for this claim would include:

a) You are ill or injured and is unable to travel

b) There is a death, illness or injury that requires hospitalisation amongst your family members

c) Compulsory quarantine, jury service, subpoena or kidnapping

d) Strike, riot or civil commotion;

e) The destination country is declared unsafe travel, through or by the general mass media

f) Natural disasters that have led to the trip being cancelled

g) A fire, storm or flood that damaged your residence

To be eligible for this claim, do note that there is a set period for these occurrences to happen.

Important notes 💡🤔️

Trip cancellation is applicable for:
- International trip for Gold and Platinum plan only (Silver plan not included in this coverage)
- Domestic trips are not covered"

Question: "Losses or Damages to Baggage / Personal Effects", Answer: "This benefit reimburses the
loss or damage of the following items:

- Baggage
- Electronic items limited to laptop, tablet and handphone
- Personal Effects such as clothes, jewellery, watches [limited to Ringgit Malaysia Five Hundred
(RM500) for any one article or a pair or a set of articles]

Important note💡🤔️

- Subject to terms and conditions"


Question: "Personal Money", Answer: "This benefit covers the loss of your coins, bank notes, postal
money orders or traveler's cheque due to theft or violence during your trip.
Just make sure you make a police report within 24 hours from the incident.
*Subject to terms and conditions"

<!-- page 7 -->
Question: "Missed Travel Connection", Answer: "Missed your connecting transport because there
was a delay with your incoming transport? This benefit will cover you up to a set limit according to
your plan.
*Subject to terms and conditions. Not applicable if alternative transportation is provided by the
transport company at least six (6) hours from your arrival time
Important notes 💡🤔️
Remember to get a written confirmation from the transportation company on the schedule
departure time and actual departure time to claim this benefit"

Question: "Trip Curtailment", Answer: "Sometimes, we may need to cut our trip short due to
medical emergencies, natural disasters or other unforeseen circumstances.
If this is the case, you will be compensated up to a set limit state in your plan.
*Subject to terms and conditions
Important notes 💡🤔️
Trip curtailment is applicable to:
- International trip for Gold and Platinum plan only (Silver plan not included in this coverage)
- Domestic travel not covered"


Question: "Travel Documents", Answer: "This benefit covers the loss of your passport or visas due to
theft or violence during your trip.
Just make sure you make a police report within 24 hours from the incident
*Subject to terms and conditions"

Question: "Medical Related Expenses", Answer: "Medical expenses is applicable for:
- International only
- Domestic due to accident only

Medical related expenses usually refers to reimbursement for medical, hospital and treatment
expenses, including certain emergency dental treatment that may happen on your holiday.

Any out-patient medical expenses claims for an amount not exceeding RM 3,000 for any one
Accident/incident will be on a reimbursement basis.

However, in case of Hospital Admission (for international plan only) due to injuries or illnesses, any
in-patient medical expenses incurred during your trip will be based on cashless admission."

Question: "Follow-up Treatment", Answer: "Follow-up treatment is applicable for:
- International only

<!-- page 8 -->
- Domestic due to accident only

It's reimbursement of up to the set limit for follow-up medical, hospital and treatment expenses
(including the cost of a private ambulance or professional home-nursing fees) that happens within
three (3) months after you return from your trip to Malaysia."

Question: "Alternative Treatment", Answer: "Alternative treatment applicable for:
- Platinum plan only

If there are accidents or illnesses that happened during your trip and you are planning to undergo
alternative treatments like traditional medicine, osteopathy and more, we will reimburse you up to
the set limit within 3 months after you return from your trip to Malaysia.

The treatment must be carried out by a registered traditional medicine practitioner, osteopath,
physiotherapist and/or chiropractor as long as you consult a Medical Practitioner in the first place so
make sure you get the green light from a doctor first before you proceed."

Question: "Compassionate Care", Answer: "Compassionate care is applicable for:
- International only

In case of illness or death that occurs during a trip, this reimbursement of up to a set limit covers the
accommodation, communication, round trip economy class air tickets, meals and travel expenses
between Malaysia and the place of loss for 1 person who is required to travel:

a) due to your hospitalisation at the medical advice of the treating physician; or

b) as a result of your death during the trip,
provided no adult member of your family is present during the trip."

Question: "Child Care / Guard and Return of Child(ren)", Answer: "Child care/Guard and Return of
Child(ren) is applicable for:
- International only

This refers to reimbursement of up to a set limit for accommodation, communication, round trip
economy class air ticket, meals, travel expenses between Malaysia and the holiday destination,
incurred by 1 person to take care of and/or accompany the insured/covered person's Child(ren),
below 18 years old, back to Malaysia due to your hospitalisation, where no other adult member is
present during the trip."

Question: "Daily Hospital Income / Hospital Confinement", Answer: "Should you be hospitalised
during your trip, you will receive a daily hospital allowance of up to a set limit for each day of the
duration of your stay, not exceeding 20 days.

<!-- page 9 -->
Terms and conditions apply."

Question: "Emergency Medical Evacuation", Answer: "In case of a medical emergency, contact the
24-Hours Travel and Medical Assistance Helpline to request for emergency transportation.

However, if you are in a location where you are unable to reach our Helpline, the emergency
transportation you used must be reported as soon as possible.

Don't worry, call +603-2785-6565 to get help for oversea related matters.

Important notes💡🤔️

This benefit is applicable for:
- International trip due to accident and illness only
- Domestic trip covered due to accident only"

Question: "Repatriation, Burial & Cremation of Mortal Remains", Answer: "In the unfortunate even
that death happens during the trip, we will cover the cost for the burial or cremation and cost of
transport of body or ashes to Malaysia.

Don't worry, call +603-2785-6565 to get help for oversea related matters."
</ Emergency Travel Helpline>

Question: "What is the maximum number of days I can get covered for my travel?", Answer: "For
Single Trip (International)
- Up to 180 days

For Annual Trip (International)
- Up to 90 days

For Single Trip (Domestic)
- Up to 30 days"

Question: "I am already traveling overseas. Can I still purchase a plan?", Answer: "Unfortunately, you
won't be able to. In order to get covered, you must depart from Malaysia and return back to
Malaysia."

<!-- page 10 -->
Question: "What is the password to open the policy?", Answer: "The password to open the
documents is: Your Date of Birth + the 4 last digit of the IC/Passport you used to purchase the
coverage. Example: DDMMYYYYXXXX

Remember, don't share your password with anyone else."
